scope: Chinese-primary source expansion; metadata and bounded public sample audits only
warning: Counts marked publisher_reported are not measured. No source is admitted by size or age alone. This is research triage, not legal advice. No raw corpus redistribution.

sources.provenance_dates: Source papers 2010–2020; dataset paper 2022. These dates do not identify individual generation histories.
metadata: title/abstract/keywords/category/discipline in original release; sampled task file has only prompt, abstract, discipline
sources.rights: README declares Apache-2.0 using software boilerplate; paper explicitly states permission for metadata NLP research. Do not silently equate this with unrestricted downstream commercial text rights.
limitations: Not full papers or general human language
Sample median 193.5 characters; no author/date/paragraph structure
Same 10,000 documents reused across four task views; never count views as new texts
Disciplines reflect single-field journals, not independent genres
sources.next_step: Use original abstract text once, matched by discipline/length. Expand only task rows needed; do not fetch 1.83GB reformatted pretraining mirror.

sources.provenance_dates: Official 2015-03-09 snapshot; collections 2010–2012/2015. 19,039 message timestamps missing; available years 2005 and 2008–2012.
metadata: contributor pseudonym, collection method/time, some send timestamps, demographics; do not export identifiers/demographics
sources.rights: Creator paper states open-license/public-domain methodology, intended unrestricted access/use and informed voluntary contribution of personally sent texts. No SPDX/CC0 file in repository; do not relabel as CC0.
limitations: Median 11 characters; only 64 messages reach 100 characters
Raw weighted effective author count 56.953; top ten supply 35.9%
Names were not scrubbed; age<=18/ambiguous/unknown records require exclusion
Not natural conversations or gold discourse labels; topic labels absent
sources.next_step: Retain only privacy-screened known-over18 records; balance contributors, deduplicate globally and by author, manually label topic before author-held-topic testing. Never expose messages or pseudonyms.

sources.provenance_dates: 2018 corpus/paper; individual dates reportedly retained. Snapshot does not rule out spam/bots/copied text.
metadata: anonymized user, book, tag, date, rating, likes
sources.rights: README claims CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 but also prohibits redistribution, requires takedown on owner request, and assigns underlying copyright to reviewers/Douban. Scope conflict and source permissions unresolved.
limitations: Many users and books are not proof of broad genre coverage
Book/topic/author correlations; syndicated comments and coordinated reviewing
Width/special-symbol/script normalization alters style
sources.next_step: Resolve dataset terms and original rights first; then inspect a bounded author-by-book sample and cross-book/genre splits. No corpus transfer yet.

sources.provenance_dates: 2018 release; per-post dates and author IDs still unverified.
metadata: subject directory, topic JSON file; row schema not yet inspected
sources.rights: Creator README allows study/research, excludes unauthorized commercial use and all redistribution, preserves original owners and takedowns; contains Douban wording even for Chiphell.
limitations: Hardware/motors/clothes/news are topics within forum register
Thread-level records contain multiple speakers; never assign whole thread to one author
Rights/author IDs/date quality not established
sources.next_step: First shard is exact 15,665,368 bytes. Before its acquisition, settle research-only fit and rights wording; inspect thread/speaker/date schema and duplicates, not a giant unstratified merge.

sources.provenance_dates: Select publication <=2021 and verify PDF publication dates per item.
metadata: DOI/title, date, authors, journal, section headings, article-specific CC notice
sources.rights: Publisher states authors can select CC BY or CC BY-NC; verify individual PDF. Site-wide open-access label alone is insufficient.
limitations: Not single-author voice; coauthor/editor effects
Same source appears in GCDT academic validation, requiring document-level exclusion
Scientific fields still one broad register
sources.next_step: Coordinate gold-corpus exclusion with discourse worker; next bounded acquisition should sample <=20 pre-2022 papers across fields after article-license checks.

counts.unique_authors: unverified; 45 named collectors are not authors

sources.provenance_dates: Mostly 2014 publications; built 2015–2017. Companion ToRCH2009 has no overlapping files according to creator.
metadata: genre codes A–R, collection documentation; author/date completeness not checked
sources.rights: Institution offers direct full-text ZIP but page supplies no explicit reuse license. Public download is not a clear training/republication grant.
limitations: Genre-balanced sampling is useful; does not imply author balancing
No discourse gold annotations established
Literary editions/translation/source integrity need checking
sources.next_step: Inspect accompanying documentation/rights through permitted source; confirm reuse grant before corpus admission. Valuable genre frame even if raw access stays gated.

sources.provenance_dates: Extracted from Chinese Gigaword Second Edition (2005); corpus methodology published 2022.
metadata: author, topic, fixed split, Gigaword source ID; same author across held-out topics
sources.rights: Public construction code is not a text license. Raw Xinhua is from licensed LDC Gigaword; no access obtained.
limitations: Best relevant cross-topic design, yet newswire only
Editorial/institutional voice and reporter geography remain considerations
Do not call downloadable reconstruction scripts an open raw corpus
sources.next_step: Use as methodological target. Acquire raw texts only if user already has the appropriate license; no payment/account action in this pass.

sources.provenance_dates: AAAI 2021; human-created elicited conversations, not unprompted internet writing.
metadata: dialogue turns and grounding article URLs; cross-dialogue stable speaker IDs unverified
sources.rights: Tencent-specific noncommercial scientific use license. Restricts redistribution and download from non-Tencent sources; HF license copy inspected but corpus not downloaded.
limitations: Prompt/article/topic confounding
Human dialogues and grounding news need distinct text roles
Primary Tencent download page returned 502 in this pass
sources.next_step: Resolve official Tencent access and applicable terms, inspect stable speaker IDs, then sample domains separately. Do not use convenient mirrors against stated source restriction.

metadata: bibliography, genre, source; author metadata needs inspection
sources.rights: Explicit university license supports linguistic research/language-product development, free nonprofit research; raw sharing restricted to licensed research group. End-user name/affiliation/email form.
limitations: Free does not mean unrestricted
Historical register differs from current Chinese
No registration, identity submission or raw download attempted
sources.next_step: Prefer as documented genre reference; only proceed if license/registration fits authorized research and user approves required transmission.

metadata: UTF-8 topic folders; dates/bylines may be embedded but not verified
sources.rights: THUCTC software terms are not a verified THUCNews/Sina text license. Official repository directs users to fill personal information to download.
limitations: 14 topics are not 14 genres
Wire republication/bylines/boilerplate may cause duplicates
Third-party mirrors cannot substitute for upstream permission
sources.next_step: Obtain exact dataset grant and approved access before sampling; separate headline/title derivatives from articles.

metadata: URL and text; author/date/genre not documented
sources.rights: Zenodo dataset explicitly tagged CC BY 4.0. Per-source copyright chain and source license distinctions not documented in the release.
limitations: Broad crawl is not a human-origin or representative-genre certificate
Scraped websites may copy news, include boilerplate/spam or automated text
No dedup or privacy audit yet
sources.next_step: Do not bulk download. First establish licensed source/domain strata and a small range-sampled audit; classify genre and obtain per-record provenance before any admission.

sources.provenance_dates: 2020 release; pre-2022 alone cannot prove human authorship.
metadata: utterance lists; stable author/date/source mapping unverified
sources.rights: MIT repository file coexists with README research-only dataset/model restriction; software license cannot erase it.
limitations: Large mixes Xiaohuangji/Qingyun/subtitles and other sources, blocking clean human assumption
Cleaning removes emojis/symbols/ungrammatical language central to informal style
Chinese and English README base-count tables disagree slightly
sources.next_step: Do not count 12M as human gold or genre coverage. If needed later, isolate verifiable source-specific natural-human records and retain an explicit preprocessing-bias label.

sources.provenance_dates: Original Blogger collection August 2004; Blog-1K curated release December 2022.
metadata: original author/date/self-reported age; Blog-1K id/text/split only
sources.rights: Original permits noncommercial research. Blog-1K claims ISC; derivation does not by itself prove upstream restrictions removed.
limitations: Not Chinese coverage
Original includes 8,240 authors aged 13–17; do not silently ingest
Blog-1K random fixed split is not established cross-topic validation
sources.next_step: Optional adult-only English methodology comparison after license clarification; not recommended for this Chinese corpus expansion.

sources.provenance_dates: 2020 Common Crawl-derived release; exact document dates not established.
metadata: pretraining lines/document boundaries; author/genre/date completeness unverified
sources.rights: Repository MIT is not universal rights to crawled pages. Current acquisition requires email with purpose/plan/institution/applicant information and commitment not to share.
limitations: No author-cross-topic labels
100GB is not an independent sample of human styles
CLUE explicitly advises original licenses for component tasks
sources.next_step: Do not use mirrors to bypass application. Prefer smaller documented sources; no email/contact or identity submission attempted.

sources.provenance_dates: Current terms effective 2025-03-16; historical content not thereby cleared.
sources.rights: CC BY-NC-SA text banner coexists with a restriction on scraping/AI/algorithm research without written permission.
limitations: Cannot treat a broad CC banner as permission for the requested acquisition workflow
sources.next_step: No corpus crawling. Do not route via mirrors to evade the stated restriction.
